transcript: What is this musical starring Ben Platt by one of the songwriters of K-POP Demon Hunters? So it was just announced that Ben Platt is gonna be starring in the musical Midnight at the Never Get in London. Written by Mark Sonnenblick, one of the songwriters who wrote the smash hit Golden, among other songs from K-POP Demon Hunters. I love this announcement because this is a real “I saw them when” story for me when I was a literary intern at a theatre company in 2016 I was kind of unwittingly dragged along to an industry workshop presentation of this musical in the basement of Don't Tell Mama. And Mark Sonnenblick was actually performing in the show at that time. But what actually is this musical? Well, it's conceived as an intimate cabaret act at the fictional nightclub called the Never Get. And it tells a queer love story in 1960s New York. And without spoiling anything, there is maybe a bit more to this nightclub than initially meets the eye so not unlike Hedwig or Six, it's presented like a concert, but it is a musical, it tells a story and there's a whole concept around it. And I don't know exactly how David Cromer is gonna stage it in London, but it lends itself well to a kind of semi-immersive staging with maybe the audience at tables where you're sort of transported to this 1960/ nightclub. And when I saw it, I found the musical pretty emotionally potent. It explores themes of love and loss with a kind of aching tenderness that comes across really nicely in this intimate cabaret format. After its developmental performances, it had its kind of full official world premiere at the York theatre off-broadway in 2018, starring Sam Bolen and directed by Max Friedman, who are also credited as the co-conceivers of the show. But it seems to me that this london revival is gonna be the most high profile production they've had yet. Also maybe worth noting that while much of the show will rest on Ben Platt in the central role of Trevor, we can probably expect another casting announcement for the role of Arthur, who is his lover and the pianist of the nightclub act.
